name: Rural and Urban Districts 2 Apr 1911
description: The 309 county districts of Ireland on census day, 2 Apr 1911: rural districts (each the part of one poor law union in one administrative county), urban districts and the six county boroughs. Each is built by dissolving the 3,673 District Electoral Divisions of the 1911 census by the county district it is printed under in Table VI of the 1911 county volumes. Rural districts carry the names in force in 1911, with the former numbered name (for example Aghalee, formerly Lurgan No. 3) where the district was renamed about 1901-02, and their union. Each district carries its census acreage (the sum of its printed DED areas) and population; the map areas agree with them to a median of 0.2%, apart from districts on large lakes and estuaries, which the census leaves out.

references.label: Census of Ireland 1911, Area, houses and population (county volumes), Table VI
references.note: Area, houses and population of each county district and DED. Transcribed from the page images and checked against an independent OCR parse (agreement on 3,563 of 3,586 DEDs outside King's County; the differences were OCR errors).
